name: Asana
tagline: Work management API for tasks, projects, goals, and teams.
shortDescription: Asana provides REST APIs, OAuth, personal access tokens, webhooks, events, tasks, projects, and goals.
agentSummary: Agents can search, create, update, and organize work if workspace permissions are scoped carefully.
bestFor: Task triage, project updates, status reporting, and operational workflows.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Task mutations and private project data need review and clear ownership. Project, CRM, document, and spreadsheet writes depend on team context and privacy rules; require least-privilege scopes and review for workflow-changing actions. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Public seat-based pricing with plan-specific features.
authModel: Personal access tokens, OAuth apps, webhooks, and Asana MCP app integration.
browserSupport: Browser UI is helpful for project structure and approval review.

capabilities.detail: Developer docs cover tasks, projects, users, goals, webhooks, and events.
Asana offers an official MCP server for accessing the Asana Work Graph from compatible AI assistants.
Docs include API reference, guides, auth, and webhook examples.
Pricing is public by plan and seat.
Browser UI is helpful for project structure and approval review.
